answer.text: AU-WEST's SLA breach rate was 8.72% in Oct 2025, 10.88% in Nov, 7.65% in Dec, 30.48% in Jan 2026, 9.48% in Feb and 6.06% in Mar. January stands out as a sharp spike compared with the other months.
assumptions: Period covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31, grouped by calendar month.
sla_breach_rate: percentage of tickets that breached their resolution SLA.

sql.sql:
select date_trunc('month', t.opened_date)::date as period, round(100.0 * avg(t.is_sla_breached::int), 2) as sla_breach_rate
from marts.fct_tickets as t
where t.opened_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and t.region = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 1
limit %(row_limit)s
